lastCompletedStory.title: Add shared spread-forwarding spawnSync helper and harden on-main SpawnFn option surface

nextStoryContext: realOnMainSpawnFn is now exported from src/git/on-main.ts (SpawnFn type widened with maxBuffer?: number). It is NOT yet wired into any real call-site: src/commands/spec.ts still has two inline duplicate closures (lines ~280-282, ~389-391) with the identical spread-forwarding body, and src/release/post-merge.ts's makeRealIssueSpawnFn (the actual CAM-307 bug site: field-by-field destructure of encoding/env/input, dropping maxBuffer, used by defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn/defaultDemoteIssueFn which all flow through issue-specify.ts's readBacklogFromMain(cwd, toBacklogSpawn(spawnFn)) calls) is unchanged. US-002 covers file-local/triage/suggestions-promote wrappers; US-003 covers post-merge.ts's makeRealIssueSpawnFn plus a >1 MiB ship auto-close regression test and a full consumer audit. Do not re-litigate US-001's scope decision to leave call-sites untouched -- it was deliberate per notes and the US-002/US-003 split.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed spawnSync's documented default maxBuffer (1024*1024), truncation-on-exceed behavior, and that encoding/env/input/maxBuffer are all independent optional options fields forwarded as-is -- matches the { ...opts, stdio: 'pipe' } spread body and the empirical ENOBUFS observed in the new test.
